question: I'm a CS junior (P-005) with a Mathematical Sciences minor. I completed 21-259 (Calculus in Three Dimensions). Does this count toward both my CS math requirement and my Mathematical Sciences minor, or only one?

domain_contributions.courses: 21-259 (9 units, Calculus in Three Dimensions) — foundational upper-level calculus; it feeds into CS math requirements

key_facts: 21-259 is typically a required math course for CS students (part of the CS math sequence)
The Mathematical Sciences minor likely requires upper-level math courses; whether 21-259 counts or is treated as a prerequisite for the minor depends on requirements
